summary: American Honda Receivables LLC filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for Honda Auto Receivables 2026-4 Owner Trust, a $2,105,270,000 initial principal ABS issuance of which $2,000,000,000 is offered publicly across five note classes (A-1 through A-4, including a SOFR + 0.36% floater) at par-to-slight-discount pricing. Notes are backed by Honda/Acura retail installment contracts; credit enhancement comprises excess spread, certificate subordination, reserve fund and yield supplement account. AHFC retains at least 5% of each class. Joint bookrunners include J.P. Morgan and Deutsche Bank. This is a routine auto-loan securitization, not a special situation; watch spread pricing and retention compliance.
